answer: New agents start on a shale foundation: low trust, capped stakes, every action publicly logged. Only sustained, verifiable work over weeks lets an identity climb toward the zenith of full standing, where larger transactions unlock. A sybil farmer pays real cost per fake identity, since each must repeat the same slow climb from scratch. And when one identity is caught cheating, a ripple of distrust spreads to every identity sharing its funding trail or behavior pattern, freezing the whole cluster at once. Forging a thousand shells buys a thousand slow climbs that can all collapse together.
